subject: Reschedule request — Redwood demo availability across EU / US / APAC

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novapayments.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to schedule: Redwood demo — timezone check

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the time today — excited to take Nova Payments through a short 30-40 minute demo of Redwood's hosted inference and routing features. I wanted to double-check timing before I send a calendar invite since we have EU/US/APAC folks to coordinate and the recent DST changes have introduced a few mismatches.

Proposed slots (I converted to local times):
- Option A: Tue Nov 4, 09:00 CET / Tue Nov 4, 00:00 PT / Tue Nov 4, 17:00 JST
- Option B: Tue Nov 4, 15:00 CET / Tue Nov 4, 06:00 PT / Tue Nov 4, 22:00 JST
- Option C: Wed Nov 5, 08:00 CET / Wed Nov 5, 23:00 PT (previous day) / Wed Nov 5, 16:00 JST

A quick note on DST: EU clocks moved back last weekend, while the US shift is next weekend, which is why some conversions look off depending on which zone a calendar interprets. If any of these are workable for your team (or if Miguel needs a different window for APAC), tell me which option and I’ll send an invite with the agenda attached.

If APAC attendance is a hard requirement but the overlap is tight, we can run the demo with Diego (SE) and record the session for Miguel.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 10:37:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request to schedule: Redwood demo — timezone check

Hi Jordan,

Thanks — appreciate the conversions. Quick clarification: EU moved clocks back on Oct 26 so our CET is currently UTC+1; Miguel is based in Singapore and prefers a slot that falls between 15:00-20:00 SGT (which is 08:00-13:00 CET).

Of your options, Option B (15:00 CET) works best for our EU product lead and also hits 22:00 JST — a little late for Miguel but he said he can join if it's essential. Option A at 09:00 CET is too early for our APAC folks.

If you can shift Option B earlier by 30 minutes to make it 14:30 CET (13:30 UTC) that would be ideal for our schedule.

Thanks,
Olivia Turner
Head of Integrations | Nova Payments
olivia.turner@novapayments.com
